👋 About Me
Hi, I’m Wondimagegn Zewudu Wakjira — a passionate Full Stack Developer, Data Analyst, and Tech Visionary from Ethiopia 🇪🇹.

With over 7+ years of hands-on experience, I specialize in building robust, scalable, and intelligent digital solutions. From national-scale platforms like election management systems to immersive tourism experiences using Three.js, my portfolio blends backend intelligence with frontend finesse — and a dash of machine learning, cybersecurity, and data visualization magic.

🔧 Tech I use daily: React.js, Node.js, NestJS, Python, Django, React Native, Three.js, SQL, Cytoscape.js
🛠️ Project domains: Government systems, e-tourism, real-time data apps, LMS, cybersecurity, payment systems
